name: Khatta Mitha
ingredients_raw: Gram Flour (31%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil, Corn Oil), Sugar Powder (13%), Rice Flakes (8%), Rice Flour (7%), Gram Pulse, Red Lentils, Raisins, Ground Nuts (Peanuts), Sago, Coconut, Common Salt, Black Salt, Spices and Condiments (Asafoetida Powder, Turmeric Powder, Coriander Powder, Cumin, Black Pepper, Cassia, Dried Ginger, Fenugreek Leaves, Black Cardamom, Yellow Chillies, Cloves, Nutmeg and Mace), Curry Leaves, Acidity Regulator (INS 330) and Raising Agent (INS 500ii)
